name: duopore-public-pdf-tables
description: Turn checked PDF table rows into an Excel file you can work with.

interface.longDescription: Turn checked PDF table rows into an Excel file you can work with. Share your table rows, check each value, and keep the page number beside it. This helps you trace a cell back to its source. The website can read PDFs with selectable text; scans need a separate text-reading step. ChatGPT accepts up to 200 reviewed rows and 12 columns. Downloads need host support.
capabilities: Turn reviewed table rows into Excel
defaultPrompt: Turn these checked PDF table rows into Excel.
Keep the source page and the leading zeros in this table.
